definitions.explanation: Cheap relative to what you get, or cheaper compared to alternatives. Implies good value for money.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割安|わりやす}でおいしい。
examples.english: This restaurant is affordable and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{割安|わりやす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Buying in bulk makes it cheaper per unit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランチ→ランチ：11196_ranchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{割安|わりやす}な⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Weekday lunches can be enjoyed at more affordable prices compared to dinner.

notes:
{割安|わりやす} means relatively cheap or good value for the price. It emphasizes that something is cheaper than expected or compared to alternatives, not just cheap in absolute terms.

FORMS:
⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ (ratio, proportion) + {安|やす} (cheap) — cheap relative to the value you get.
- Na-adjective: {割安|わりやす}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (a good-value product)
- Noun: {割安|わりやす}{感|かん} (sense of being a good deal)
- Adverbial: {割安|わりやす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧ (can buy at a good price)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割安|わりやす}な⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧ (affordable/bargain price)
- ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{割安|わりやす} (buying in bulk is cheaper per unit)
- {割安|わりやす}⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧ (undervalued stock — in finance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- Opposite: ⟦{割高|わりだか}→割高：14734_waridaka⟧ (relatively expensive, poor value for money)
- ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ is simply 'cheap,' while {割安|わりやす} implies good value relative to quality or alternatives
